criteria.text: The selected native coordinator receives current source and trusted requirement context for unchecked or changed work before selection; no automatic model call is made.
A completed independent analysis saves an explicit empty dependency list. A product question stays a question and writes no native edge.
A stale completion is pending and writes no review or native edge. A proposed cycle is refused before any save.
Work owned by another machine is skipped instead of starting another owner.
Reading repository B from repository A or from no checkout never borrows A-only trust. Its native graph stays visible while unverified review authority keeps work ineligible.
Source-backed prepare and completion use the same durable input revisions. A changed or missing required source stays pending without an edge; an unrelated file change does not replace a review.

A new unrelated issue is reviewed first with both-direction impact against exact saved heads. The two unchanged reviews are reused after restart. If one head is affected, only that issue is queued next.
